# Image Prompt Pack - 001 Messi Hate Shift

## Purpose

Use image generation for impact frames, evidence-board inserts, and stylized animation bursts. Blender remains the main animation engine, but generated frames can add dramatic texture.

## Timing Note

```text
10 frames x 0.02 seconds = 0.2 seconds
```

That is good for:

- impact flashes
- smear-frame motion
- transformation bursts
- glitch cuts
- title-card energy

For a longer animated beat, generate more frames or animate the image plane inside Blender.

## Prompt Rules

- Keep the same camera angle unless motion requires change.
- Keep the same character silhouette across frames.
- Mention frame number and incremental movement.
- Use consistent lighting and background.
- Avoid real player likeness if we want safer stylized visuals.
